title: British Schools Champs
text:
From our Captain, Sarah:

Congratulations to all the SUFFOC juniors who took part at the British Schools Orienteering Champs in Leicestershire today.
There were a number of medal winners: Barney Steventon Barnes 1st place in Year 7 boys, Matthew Clarke 2nd place Year 10/11 boys and Tim Harrison 3rd place Year 12/13 boys. Also Barnardiston Prep School won the Middle/Prep boys team competition.

Full results can be found here.
